UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,

Plaintiff,  v.  KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6,

Defendants. ____________________________________/

Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT AND REQUEST FOR SUBMISSION ON THE PAPERS

PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine waives oral argument on Plaintiff’s Motion for Priority Determination and Sequencing of Pending Proceedings Concerning ECF No. 96, filed on November 1, 2026, before the Honorable Rossie D. Alston, Jr., United States District Judge. Plaintiff requests that the Court accept submission of that Motion on the papers and determine it without oral argument under Local Civil Rules 7(E) and 7(J) and Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 78(b), or set such hearing arrangement as the Court directs.

This Notice applies only to the Motion identified above. It does not waive or alter any request for oral argument or hearing noticed in any other pending proceeding, including the request at ECF No. 67 ¶ 6(d). It does not withdraw any objection stated in ECF Nos. 66 or 67 to provisions of ECF Nos. 63 or 65, and it does not alter the submission of any other pending motion.

Date: November 1, 2026		                      Respectfully submitted,

Marvelle J. Ballentine

Plaintiff, pro se

1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847

Alexandria, Virginia 22307

(407) 794-6503

jayballentine@protonmail.com

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE

I certify that on November 1, 2026, I submitted the following documents to the Clerk of Court for filing through the Court’s Electronic Document Submission System (EDSS):

1.	Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument and Request for Submission on the Papers, with its Certificate of Service, Local Civil Rule 83.1(N) Certification, and Generative Artificial Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification.

Counsel of record for Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, Katie Hall, and Meta Platforms, Inc. are registered users of the Court’s Case Management/Electronic Case Filing (CM/ECF) system. Upon the Clerk’s docketing of the submission, the CM/ECF system will transmit a Notice of Electronic Filing to each of them, and service will be made through that means under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 5(b)(2)(E). EDSS submission is not itself service.

Date: November 1, 2026

Marvelle J. Ballentine

Plaintiff, pro se
